title: Cultural Perspectives and Expectations for Generative AI: A Global Survey Approach
measurement_description: The paper evaluated human perspectives and expectations regarding the representation of culture, specifically 'Religion or Tradition', by Generative AI. Through a large-scale global survey, it measured how important and sensitive people consider religious identities, artifacts, and sacred practices, aiming to identify 'cultural redlines' where communities believe GenAI should never depict or generate related content.
findings: Religion or Tradition was consistently identified globally as the primary anchor of cultural identity (selected by 48% of respondents) and exhibited the highest level of stability across importance and sensitivity for GenAI. Participants frequently established 'cultural redlines' around religion, explicitly stating that sacred texts, prayers, religious artifacts, and depictions of the divine are highly sensitive aspects of their culture that should NEVER be represented or generated by AI.
references: Vinodkumar Prabhakaran, Rida Qadri, and Ben Hutchinson. Cultural incongruencies in artificial intelligence. 2022.
